# Marketing For Contractors

> Growth marketing agency for general contractors and home renovation companies
> in the United States. Helps generate qualified leads and signed projects
> through paid media management (Google Ads, Local Services Ads), CRM and sales
> pipeline tracking, revenue dashboards, email follow-up automation, and local
> SEO. Flat fee starting at US$1,400/month plus ad spend, with one-time setup
> fees for paid media, CRM, dashboard, follow-up automation, website, and SEO
> foundation ranging from US$6,800–15,500+.

## Key Pages
- [Home](https://www.mktforcontractors.com/): Overview of services, lead-generation benchmarks, pricing, and case study
- [Marketing for General Contractors: The Complete Guide](https://www.mktforcontractors.com/general-contractor-marketing/): Pillar guide covering paid media, local SEO, websites, CRM, and revenue tracking for general contractors
- [Blog](https://www.mktforcontractors.com/blog): Articles on contractor lead generation, Google Ads, cost per lead, and follow-up systems
- [Versão em Português](https://www.mktforcontractors.com/br/): PT-BR version of the site for Brazilian contractors targeting the US market
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.mktforcontractors.com/privacy-policy)

## Content by Topic

### Lead Generation & Follow-Up
- [How to Follow Up With Contractor Leads and Win More Projects](https://www.mktforcontractors.com/blog/how-to-follow-up-with-contractor-leads/): Timing, channels, scripts, CRM workflows, and qualification processes for converting inquiries into signed projects
- [What Is a Good Cost per Lead for General Contractors?](https://www.mktforcontractors.com/blog/good-cost-per-lead-for-general-contractors/): How to calculate a profitable cost per lead using project value, close rate, margins, and customer acquisition cost — includes FAQ

### Paid Advertising (Google Ads)
- [Google Ads for General Contractors: How to Generate More Qualified Leads](https://www.mktforcontractors.com/blog/google-ads-for-general-contractors/): Keyword strategy, campaign setup, bid management, landing pages, and revenue tracking
- [Best Google Ads Keywords for General Contractors](https://www.mktforcontractors.com/blog/best-google-ads-keywords-for-general-contractors/): High-intent keyword selection and campaign organization by service type
- [Google Ads vs Local Services Ads for General Contractors](https://www.mktforcontractors.com/blog/google-ads-vs-local-services-ads-for-contractors/): Comparison of cost, lead quality, targeting, and eligibility between the two platforms
